purpose: A durable, privacy-aware queue for work that can be resumed across sessions and executed by repository automation.

policy.hosting_constraint: GitHub Pages and other free infrastructure only; no paid host, paid API, or required API key.

tasks.title: Build and verify the playable Mind experience
checks: Playable Mind page exists at site/mind/index.html
Living Atlas links directly to the Mind
Guided investigation expedition, relationship map, seven rooms, local notebook, and exports are present
JavaScript syntax and mobile layout are checked
Privacy boundary is visible and local notebook is not sent to a server
tasks.completion_evidence: Workflow checks pass and a browser smoke test confirms primary interactions.

tasks.title: Make the execution loop observable and repeatable
checks: execution/queue.json exists and is valid JSON
site/validate-site.mjs passes
site/generate-catalog.mjs and site/validate-catalog.mjs parse
tools/mc_gate_integration/run_gate_check.py passes
tasks.completion_evidence: A successful workflow run and an uploaded execution report.

tasks.title: Verify the canonical Living Atlas build inputs
checks: Canonical site validation passes
Catalog generation and privacy validation pass
Generated catalog is not committed unless a deliberate reviewed change requires it

tasks.title: Verify the companion application's published routes
checks: The companion repository can be checked out
Its existing Pages build command succeeds
The application, Atlas route, and research route exist in the build output

tasks.title: Diagnose deployment blockers without bypassing repository permissions
checks: Deployment workflow status is inspected
Permission or Pages configuration blockers are reported explicitly
No credentials, secrets, or access controls are bypassed
tasks.completion_evidence: A dated diagnostic report with the blocker and the next required action.

tasks.title: Add browser smoke tests for core Living Atlas and Mind interactions
checks: Test homepage navigation
Test Mind expedition and room selection
Test notebook save/export/reset
Test narrow viewport and keyboard access
tasks.completion_evidence: Automated browser test report attached to a workflow run.
